code_findings: CardDefinition has on_play but no explicit Battlecry declaration; AbilityInstance similarly uses on_play.
resolver.play_from_hand sends all active on_play behaviors through rewind_outcomes.payload.
colossal.ColossalBattlecry delays on_play after appendages; its class name is not a general Battlecry identity.
Choose One now installs engine.choose_one as on_play for minions; generic on_play cannot be assumed to mean Battlecry.
Existing tagged representatives need deliberate migration and combination regressions, not an implicit tag-driven repetition rule.
